again.harder: More like this, a bit harder
again.harder_topic: More like this, a bit harder: {{topics}}

dictation.play_hint: Buddy reads it to you – as often as you like.

answer.mic_off: The mic is off here – you're practising spelling.
answer.placeholder_dictation: Write what you hear – no mic here
answer.label: Your answer
answer.check_waits: Only once there is something in the field.

bar.shade_how: Tap the parts of the bar.
bar.pick_how: Tap the bar that is more.
bar.check_waits: Only once a part is shaded.

cards.note: Flashcards – you say yourself whether you knew it.
cards.turn_hint: Shows the answer. Then you say yourself whether you knew it.
cards.knew_hint: Notes that you had it. The word will come round again later.
cards.not_yet_hint: Notes that you need it again. The word will come back soon.
cards.end_hint: Back to Buddy. The cards you have done stay done.
cards.done_body: You went through your words. The ones that were not there yet will come back.
cards.offer: Go through the words as cards
cards.offer_hint: Shows you the words that were not there yet, one by one – turn each over for the answer.

choice_zoom_hint: Press and hold to see the picture large.

dispute.label: Dispute the verdict
dispute.done: All right – that one does not count.
dispute.hint: Takes this question and its mark back.
dispute.sheet_body: Then I take this question out — it does not count and will not come up again. Your progress stays as it was before.

end_hint: Back to Buddy. Your answers are saved – you can carry on here later.
end_hint_test: Hands in the practice test and shows you how it went.
finish_failed: I couldn't load your result just now.
finishing: One moment – your result is on its way.
more_coming: The next questions are on their way …

flag.label: Question doesn't fit
flag.hint: Takes this question out; it won't come up again.
flag.sheet_body: This question won't come up again.
flag.done: Got it – the question is out.

help_note: Homework – I'll give you hints, you'll find the answer yourself.
later_done: All right – that one comes back later.
later_hint: The task stays open and comes back after the others.

listen.hint: Plays the text for you – as often as you like.
listen.failed: The text cannot be played right now.

match.how_pairs: Tap one on the left, then its partner on the right.
match.how_groups: Tap one at the top, then its group.
match.hint_group_waits: Tap something at the top first.

cloze.check_waits: Only once every gap has something in it.

order.hint_placed: Takes it back – and everything after it.
order.check_waits: Once every one has a place.

reexplain.label: Explain it differently?
reexplain.hint: Buddy explains it again, this way.
reexplain.thinking: Buddy is explaining it another way …
reexplain.title: Explained another way

why.label: Which reason is right?
why.hint: Shows three reasons – tap the one that's right.

self_solved.title: Solved it yourself!
self_solved.body: You worked that out on your own.

solution.title: Solution
solution.calm: Take your time to look at it.

speak.no_voice: Reading aloud isn't working on this device right now – the voice for this language may be missing.
speak.record_stop_label: Stop recording and send it to Buddy
speak.record_hint: Tap, say the sentence, then tap Done. Thirty seconds at most.
speak.waiting_offline: No connection right now. Your recording will be sent as soon as you're back online.
speak.send_failed: Your recording hasn't reached Buddy yet.
speak.denied: Without the microphone I can't hear you. You can allow it in Settings.
speak.denied_web: Without the microphone I can't hear you. Allow it at the top of your browser, then tap Speak again.

problem.too_short: That was very short. Tap Speak, say the whole sentence, then tap Done.
problem.unsupported: I can't read this recording, sorry. Please try again.
problem.failed: The recording didn't work. Please try again.

speak.word_hint: Just this word – it does not count towards the question.
speak.word_again: Almost – listen again and try it.

staff.no_sound: No sound is coming out here right now.
staff.bar_crowded: There is no room for another symbol in bar {{n}}.
staff.bar_hint: Tap where the note should go. Then move it with “Higher” and “Lower”.
staff.check_waits: Only once every bar has something in it.
staff.taps_waits: First tap the rhythm you heard.

summary_line.all_first: All of it right the first time.

summary_test.title: Practice test done!
summary_test.time_up_line_one: In the time you answered {{answered}} of {{count}} question.
summary_test.time_up_line_other: In the time you answered {{answered}} of {{count}} questions.
summary_test.time_up_rest: What stayed open does not count as wrong.

test_note: Practice test – one answer per question, no hints. You'll see the result at the end.

thread.thinking: Buddy is looking at your answer …
thread.thinking_question: Buddy is thinking about your question …

table.check_waits: Only once every cell is filled in.

drill.end_hint: Back to Buddy. What you worked out stays saved.

line.better_times: Your {{n}} times table is sitting better now.
line.better_divide: Dividing by {{n}} is sitting better now.
line.solid_times: Your {{n}} times table is already solid.
line.again_times: We'll keep at the {{n}} times table.

timer.note: One answer per question, no hints.
timer.soon: Calmly see what else you can do.
timer.up: Time is up – your result is on its way.

reading.label: Reading text
reading.show_hint: Shows the text for this question.
reading.hide_hint: Folds the text away so the question has more room.
reading.scroll_hint: The text scrolls on its own; the question stays where it is.

mark.how_gaps: Tap the word a comma is missing after.
mark.check_waits: Only once you have marked at least one place.
mark.how_sorted: Choose the kind above, then tap the words.
mark.how_lines: Tap the lines where the text says so.

select.several: More than one is right – tap all of them.
select.check_waits: Once you've ticked at least one.

grid.how_points: Tap the crossing where the point belongs.
grid.how_graph: Set {{count}} points that lie on the graph.
grid.how_mirror: Set the image points: tap the crossings.
grid.how_bars: Tap in a column – the bar grows up to there.
grid.paper_mirror: Squared paper with a mirror line
grid.tap_hint: Sets the next point on the crossing. Tapping a point takes it away.
grid.tap_hint_bars: Pulls the bar in this column up to here.
grid.check_waits: Only once every point is set.
grid.check_waits_bars: Only once you have drawn a bar.

ask.label: Your question about the task
ask.later_hint: Buddy comes back to it after practice.

tap.check_waits: Only once you have tapped the figure.

column.check_waits: Once you have written a digit.

essay.revise: Rework these places – your text is still in the field. Then send me the new version.
essay.last: That was your last version for now. Take these points into your next text.

work.read: Copied from your photo. Does every line match your exercise book?
work.unread_one: I couldn't read line {{lines}}. Write it in yourself.
work.unread_other: I couldn't read lines {{lines}}. Write them in yourself.
work.unreadable: I can't read your photo for sure. Take it again – bright and straight from above – or type your working.
work.no_working: I can't find your working for this task on the photo. Photograph your own working – or type it.
work.too_long: That's more than fits in one answer. Photograph only your working for this task.
work.down: I can't read your photo right now. Type your working or try again in a moment.
work.camera_blocked: LearnBuddy isn't allowed to use the camera yet. You can allow it in Settings – or type your working.
work.camera_failed: The camera didn't open. Try again or type your working.
